theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (S : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P), MeasurableSet S → (∀ w ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ w) → (∀ w ∈ S, Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ w)) → InjOn Φ S → (∀ w ∈ S, G (Φ w) ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ∧ ∀ e : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (G (Φ w)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w e) = e 0) → ∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in Φ '' (S ∩ {w | w 0 = t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t : ℝ, (∫⁻ x in Φ '' (S ∩ {w | w 0 = t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) = ∫⁻ x in Φ '' S, ‖G x‖ₑ * φ x ∂μHE[n + 1]
